images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Dwelling | 60

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card: a small 1950s ranch in lap aluminium siding with a jalousie- or screen-enclosed porch on one end, small high windows on the side wall (bedrooms), young spruce and a low stone edging along the foundation, a TV antenna, a chain-link fence along the side line; a raw new yard

why.note: cheap galvanised chain-link, the postwar side and back fence
factory-finished aluminium lap siding: the new low-maintenance cladding of the 1950s
